About dbt Meetups
dbt Meetups are networking events open to everyone working with data! Talks typically focus on community members’ experiences with dbt. You may also hear presentations on broader topics such as analytics engineering, modern data stacks, data operations, modeling, testing, and team structures.

🤝 Organizer: b.telligent & dbt
🏠 Venue: b.telligent / Ruby Paul Workspaces

To attend this event, please review and agree to the Health and Safety Policy and Terms of Participation: https://www.getdbt.com/legal/health-and-safety-policy

📝 Agenda

18:00 – 18:30 | Check-in & Registration (30 min)
18:30 – 18:35 | Welcome: b.telligent & dbt (5 min)
18:35 – 19:00 | Daniel Toth - Building Better Data Pipelines with dbt and Snowflake - and a Little Help from AI (25 min)
19:00 – 19:25 | Sergej Kaiser - Teamwork Instead of Single Player: From SQL Notebook Handover to a Shared dbt Workflow (25 min)
19:25 – 19:50 | Sean McIntyre - Congratulations! You are a Context Engineer (25 min)
19:50 – 21:00 | Closing, Snacks & Networking

Presentation Details

🗣️ Presentation #1: Building Better Data Pipelines with dbt and Snowflake - and a Little Help from AI
Speaker: Daniel Toth, Senior Solutions Engineer, Snowflake
The talk explores how teams can use dbt and Snowflake to turn raw data into reliable, reusable datasets. We will cover the basics and current developments - including Slim CI, native defer-to-production, concurrent executions, dbt Fusion, and Cortex Code - and show how they simplify development, testing, deployment, and day-to-day ops. Attendees will leave with a practical mental model and concrete ideas for evaluating dbt Projects on Snowflake, including how AI can streamline development and help engineers work more efficiently.

🗣️ Presentation #2: Teamwork Instead of Single Player: From SQL Notebook Handover to a Shared dbt Workflow
Speaker: Sergej Kaiser, Senior ML/Data Engineer, b.telligent
Data analysts understand the business logic, write SQL notebooks and hand them over to engineers to make them production ready. That is how analysts and engineers collaborate in many projects.
At a fintech client, we accompanied this transition from the inside: from separate notebooks to joint work on one dbt project on a data lakehouse. The result: analysts who ship logic to production more independently, and engineers who moved from gatekeeper to enabler.
A field report on how the roles of analysts and engineers changed, and how one team balances speed, quality standards and build stability inside a shared dbt project.

🗣️ Presentation #3: Congratulations! You are a Context Engineer
Speaker: Sean McIntyre, Principal Solutions Architect, dbt Labs
As AI rapidly changes how organizations work, Sean will walk you through how to add context engineering with dbt to your skillset, to help supercharge your data platform and derive greater and more valuable insights.

Community Links
➡️ Join the dbt community: https://www.getdbt.com/community/
🤝 Join the #local-dach channel in Slack: https://slack.getdbt.com/

About dbt Labs
Since 2016, dbt Labs has been on a mission to help data practitioners create and share organizational knowledge. dbt is the standard for AI-ready structured data. Powered by the dbt Fusion engine, it delivers the performance, context, and trust organizations need to scale analytics in the era of AI.
More than 60,000 data teams worldwide use dbt, including teams at Siemens, Roche, and Condé Nast.
Learn more at getdbt.com, and follow dbt Labs on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
